26: What effect does the prayer of the High Priest have when the High Priest would recite the brief prayer on Yom Kippur - as he would say, "And let not the prayer of travelers enter Your presence." For Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa would negate the prayer of the High Priest. As the Holy One, blessed be He, would listen to [Rabbi Chanina's] prayer, in spite of it, and stop the rain.
Shechunah: Hot; similarly, Yonatan ben Uziel translates (Isaiah 44:16), "I am warm, I can feel the fire," (in the Targum, as), shachenit.
